label: prf:knot-factor-shell-closed
title: Proof of knot factor shell closed
html:
Proof. Under Z = N even-even, every neutron crossing is matched by a proton crossing of opposite sign, and the Wigner pairing (Wigner np pairing) annihilates all non-trivial \lambda-block contributions. The only surviving projection is onto the trivial irrep e_{(n)}, on which \chi_{(n)}(\beta_\mathcal{K} \cdot \beta_\mathcal{K}^*) = \chi_{(n)}(\mathbf{1})^2. The ratio in (knot factor) is therefore 1. \square

Application. {}^4\mathrm{He}, {}^{12}\mathrm{C}, {}^{16}\mathrm{O}, {}^{40}\mathrm{Ca}, {}^{56}\mathrm{Fe}, {}^{208}\mathrm{Pb} all sit in this regime; each has a_\mathcal{K} = 1 by Markov-chain equilibrium.
